items.name: Input: Disable Cursor Suppression
items.description: Disables a cursor-related desktop suppression flag, but this writes UserPreferencesMask and can cause UI side effects on some systems.

steps.command:
$desktopKey = "HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop"
$backupKey = "HKCU:\Software\FalconOptimizer\Backups"
New-Item -Path $backupKey -Force | Out-Null
$existing = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $desktopKey -Name UserPreferencesMask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UserPreferencesMask
if ($null -ne $existing) {
  Set-ItemProperty -Path $backupKey -Name UserPreferencesMask_PreFalcon -Type Binary -Value $existing
}
Set-ItemProperty -Path $desktopKey -Name UserPreferencesMask -Type Binary -Value ([byte[]](0x9e,0x3e,0x07,0x80,0x12,0x00,0x00,0x00))
Write-Output "UserPreferencesMask updated; previous value backed up to HKCU\Software\FalconOptimizer\Backups when available."

items.name: Telemetry: WER Queue Cleaner
items.description: Deletes local WER report queue/cache files to reclaim disk and reduce stale crash junk.

steps.command: $paths=@("$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportQueue","$env:ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\WER\ReportArchive","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\WER"); foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path $p){ Remove-Item -Path $p -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Output "WER queues cleaned."

items.name: Input: Force 1:1 Mouse Movement

items.notRecommendedFor: Users who prefer Windows enhanced pointer precision behavior.
